deviations.what: sap.m.Input.valueHelpIconSrc is @since 1.84 - the custom value-help icon IS this sample, so it is kept 1:1 and the port needs a UI5 runtime >= 1.84.

handleValueHelp loads Dialog.fragment.xml and opens it; the port builds the same SelectDialog in its own chain and shows it with popup_display. The dialog gets an id so the search filter can address its items binding.

_handleValueHelpSearch filters the dialog's items by Name, reproduced 1:1 with follow_up_action binding_call; _handleValueHelpClose writes the picked title into the Input (the title travels as an event arg) and closes the popup.
The value-help dialog, its search filter and the value write-back are unverified in a running system.
